elements.requirement: The table in Schedule 1 to the Tobacco Products Duty Act 1979 (TPDA 1979) is substituted with a new table specifying duty rates for tobacco products.
elements.quote: For the table in Schedule 1 to TPDA 1979 substitute

elements.requirement: The rate of duty on cigarettes is an amount equal to 16.5 per cent of the retail price plus £176.22 per thousand cigarettes.
elements.quote: 1. CigarettesAn amount equal to 16.5 per cent of the retail price plus £176.22 per thousand cigarettes

elements.requirement: The rate of duty on cigars is £219.82 per kilogram.
The rate of duty on hand-rolling tobacco is £172.74 per kilogram.
The rate of duty on other smoking tobacco and chewing tobacco is £96.64 per kilogram.
elements.quote: 4. Other smoking tobacco and chewing tobacco£96.64 per kilogram

elements.requirement: The amendment substituting the table in Schedule 1 to TPDA 1979 is treated as having come into force at 6 pm on 20 March 2013.
elements.quote: The amendment made by this section is treated as having come into force at 6 pm on 20 March 2013.

thresholds.what: Percentage of the retail price payable on cigarettes
thresholds.quote: 16.5 per cent of the retail price
